title: NEW YEAR IN CUSCO 2025
short_description: Celebrate New Year in Cusco with a trip full of culture, history, and festivities. Includes Machupicchu, city tour, and a special New Year’s Eve dinner.
long_description: Experience an unforgettable New Year in the historical capital of Peru. This package combines Andean tradition, archaeology, gastronomy, and the most energetic celebrations of the year in Cusco's Main Square. Includes a guided visit to Machupicchu, City Tour, Sacred Valley, and a special New Year’s Eve dinner.
price_note: Includes accommodation, transfers, entrance fees, and New Year’s Eve dinner.

days.title: Day 1: Welcome + Cusco City Tour
days.text: We will pick you up from the airport and take you to your hotel. In the afternoon, you will enjoy the City Tour visiting Qorikancha, Sacsayhuaman, Qenqo, Puca Pucara, and Tambomachay. Free evening to adapt to the altitude.

days.title: Day 2: Sacred Valley + Special New Year’s Eve Dinner
days.text: Visit Pisac, the artisan market, Ollantaytambo, and Chinchero. In the evening, enjoy a special New Year’s Eve dinner in Cusco. Optional: celebration in the Main Square to welcome the New Year.

days.title: Day 3: Machupicchu - The Big Day
days.text: Early in the morning, board the train to Aguas Calientes and then take the bus up to Machupicchu. Guided tour of approximately 2.5 hours. Free time for photos and exploration. Return to Cusco in the afternoon or evening.

days.title: Day 4: Farewell
days.text: Free morning for shopping or walking around. Transfer to the airport or bus station according to your itinerary.
